verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as batch editing, multi-select actions, or bulk updates across many pages or items. The editor agent can edit pages, reorganize navigation, and search the whole repository, and automations run that agent on a schedule or on events. Neither is described as acting on many items at once, so both are only adjacent. Editing files in bulk through Git would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
